I am not in Boston this morning, but I can confirm that Igor Chernyshov returned to San Jose for more evaluation of his upper-body injury. #SJSharks

Yesterday, Jakub Dobes came back on his penalty against the Sharks, and he had interesting things to say, the latest in my article for @Thehockeynews: thehockeynews.com/nhl/montreal... #GoHabsGo #CH #Canadiens #Habs #THN

Igor Chernyshov will be out long-term for the #SJSharks. With Wennberg already out week to week, what's next? Read more on Sharks Hockey Digest.

#SJSharks Askarov on his incredible save: "That's a super quick play. I know I was late, and I was like, 'Just dive to the right side. I did a big exhale after that. I was like, "Ooh, thank God, it is in the glove."

Collin Graf and Yaroslav Askarov led the #SJSharks to their first regulation win of the season. Read the recap on Sharks Hockey Digest.
